fixture.scope: Single previously used development recording; not held out. No generalization claim for other songs, performers, or full mixes.
fixture.referenceScope: Published hexaphonic-pickup-derived note annotations, used as supplied; no new manual performance annotation.

protocol.matching: One-to-one maximum cardinality, separately for each criterion; raw fractional reference MIDI, inclusive bounds with 1e-9 arithmetic epsilon.
protocol.denominators: Every reference note and every prediction; no alignment, trimming, pitch-range filter, deduplication, or reference-tempo input. All-event scores are primary; evidence-subset scores are diagnostics.
protocol.zeroDenominators: Precision, recall, and F1 are 0 when their denominator is 0.
protocol.timing: Predicted minus reference seconds, on deterministic onset/pitch matches only; p90 uses nearest rank. This matching maximizes count, not timing quality.
protocol.stringAmbiguity: String-level reference multiplicity is retained, including unisons. A mono pitch event cannot identify its original string.

stringPlacementDiagnostic.scope: Agreement with the recorded string; valid alternate fingerings can disagree. This is not a requirement for pitch correctness or a claim of recovered fingering.

playingStyleDiagnostic.reason: These JAMS annotations contain no strumming/picking or stroke-direction ground truth. Dataset genre and comp/solo mode are not technique labels.

hostTimings.scope: Single Linux/Node host pass; not phone latency

provenance.citation: Q. Xi, R. M. Bittner, J. Pauwels, X. Ye, and J. P. Bello, GuitarSet: A Dataset for Guitar Transcription, ISMIR, 2018.
